title: Preserve exact Wave 4 candidate integrity across governed runtime promotion

phases.objective: Preserve the immutable unpromoted Wave 4 candidate inspection contract while independently proving that the current repository contains only the exact separately reviewed runtime-sequence promotion and dependency registration, with authorization and Apply still blocked.

e2e_journeys.actor: Spec 014 durable injection candidate and promotion integrity guard
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: The exact Wave 4 SQL candidate, historical candidate contract, current runtime migration sequence, dependency registry, and promotion contract
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The historical candidate remains byte-exact and independently testable as unpromoted, while the current repository proves one exact Wave 4 promotion and dependency registration without granting authorization, Apply, live access, dispatch, deployment, or Production authority.
steps: Read and hash the exact Wave 4 candidate migration file.
Inspect the candidate against a synthetic pre-promotion snapshot that excludes Wave 4 from the runtime sequence and dependency registry.
Compare parsed candidate statements exactly with the reviewed contract-local DDL and require the state table before the rollback child table.
Bind the candidate to the exact Wave 3 migration, checksum, statement count, and apply-ledger dependency.
Verify the current runtime sequence contains Wave 4 exactly once at position four with the reviewed checksum, statement count, dependency, and zero-risk repository preflight.
Verify the dependency registry contains one exact Wave 4 record with one exact Wave 3 apply-ledger dependency.

Verify the separate promotion contract binds candidate PR #4879, its exact candidate head and Integration merge, and keeps authorization, dry-run, Apply, live database access, Provider dispatch, deployment, and Production readiness false.
Reject candidate checksum drift, source-parity drift, dependency drift, partial promotion, duplicate promotion, registry drift, or promotion-contract drift.
assertions: The candidate contains exactly two additive CREATE TABLE statements matching the reviewed contract-local DDL.
The historical candidate packet remains runtime_sequence_promoted=false and dependency_registry_updated=false under an exact pre-promotion fixture.
The current runtime sequence contains exactly four ordered waves and Wave 4 is the exact reviewed candidate.
The current dependency registry binds Wave 4 only to the exact Wave 3 apply ledger.
The promotion contract reports runtime_sequence_promoted=true and dependency_registry_updated=true while ready_for_authorization=false and ready_for_apply=false.

No capability resolution, authorization registry mutation, dry-run, Apply, live database access, Hostinger or SSH access, credential access, Provider dispatch, worker mount, deployment, main merge, or Production mutation occurs.

phases.objective: Create a fresh checksum-bound Wave 4 authorization only after exact successful Wave 3 apply-ledger evidence and same-cycle live compatibility readback exist.
Require exact ledger, signed readback identity, and crash-safe restart evidence before durable runtime consumption.
Observe one separately authorized non-production Wave 4 Apply and durable lifecycle canary.
This candidate-integrity slice grants no authorization, Apply, runtime, deployment, main, or Production authority.
